frequency_question: How often do central banks execute liquidity absorption measures within a short mandated operational window when macroeconomic indicators signal excess liquidity?
membership_rule: Members include formal central bank policy announcements introducing temporary or incremental reserve requirement ratios on scheduled or unscheduled monetary policy review dates. Excluded are broad, permanent statutory changes to baseline reserve requirements requiring legislative amendments.
provenance_note: claims 12 cases from only 3 named (4.0x); beyond 3.0x the skeleton is not carrying the estimate
coverage_note: 3 named instances for RBI specifically within the modern liquidity management framework; baseline frequency is sparse but entirely feasible within the calendar window.
known_gaps: Excludes minor fine-tuning operations executed via variable rate reverse repos (VRRR) which do not involve formal reserve ratio notifications.
skeleton: Total historical liquidity adjustment notifications issued by major central banks under existing statutory powers divided by total eligible policy review cycles.
multiplier: 3 policy review cycles per quarter over 4 quarters
validity_reason: Statutory powers and operational machinery of central bank liquidity management remain stable over multi-year horizons.
